pool: R2 retrieval corpus = IU training reports (corpus_study_ids.json)
exclusions_per_study: the study's own true R2 Top-5 reports
selection_uses: study id only (no reference, finding, classifier or image information)
displayed_rank_fields: dense rank, BM25 rank and fusion score are carried over from the G1 slot the sham report replaces, so the message skeleton is byte-structure-identical
evidence_table: computed by the unchanged G1 function from the sham context reports (as G1 computes it from its context)
